statement: extra += b"\xFF\xE2" + size + b"ICC_PROFILE\0" + o8(i) + o8(len(markers)) + marker
cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The code constructs JPEG APP2 marker data using external ICC profile input without validation, but CWE-74 typically requires demonstrated parsing/interpretation modification, not just data embedding

connection.evidence: External icc_profile from im.encoderinfo.get('icc_profile') flows directly into JPEG output via extra variable passed to ImageFile._save()

diff_causality.evidence: This line materially creates the ICC profile embedding mechanism by concatenating untrusted data into JPEG markers

security_control.required_control: Input validation/sanitization for ICC profile data
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-74 requires neutralization of special elements that could affect downstream parsing
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No validation of ICC profile structure, content, or special JPEG marker elements; only size constraints exist

concrete_impact.evidence: Potential for malformed ICC data to affect downstream JPEG parsers, but no demonstrated parsing modification or security consequence

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, ICC profile data would not be embedded in the JPEG output, eliminating the injection vector entirely.
supporting_evidence: External icc_profile from user input flows directly into JPEG marker construction
No validation of ICC profile content before embedding in output stream
Data passed downstream to ImageFile._save() for final JPEG writing
contradicting_evidence: ICC profile data is embedded in standardized APP2 marker format with size constraints
No demonstrated modification of parsing behavior or injection of special elements
unresolved_facts: How downstream JPEG parsers handle malformed ICC profile data
Whether ICC profile content can contain special elements that modify JPEG parsing
Concrete security impact on actual JPEG decoder implementations
